value: electrolysis of sodium chloride brine to sodium chlorate with DSA anodes, crystallisation and drying; hydrogen co-product

note: total AC electricity per tonne sodium chlorate, typical, depending on current density (electrolysis 4700-5200 plus 100-500 for pumps and compressors) [66, CEFIC-Sodium Chlorate 2004]. Cells at 2.6-3.6 V, 1-3 kA/m2, about 95% current efficiency.
energy use fell from 15,000 kWh/t in 1886 to 5,000-6,000 with modern technology
